subject.title: [Feature]: No way to view/manage paired contacts & permissions

question: Should OpenClaw add a terminal admin contact inventory for WhatsApp pairing and allowlists, and what fields, redaction, account scope, and admin authorization should it expose?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-reproducible, but exposing phone numbers/sender IDs, authorization state, and activity data is a security-sensitive product decision that overlaps `/allowlist`, `directory`, `channels status`, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56621.

options.title: Define scoped admin inventory
options.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges approved pairing store, config allowlists, directory labels, and an explicitly chosen activity source under redaction and account-scope rules.

options.title: Narrow to pairing management first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56621 for approved-list and revoke commands, then defer group-policy and last-active columns until privacy and storage are decided.

options.title: Defer to Control UI design
options.body: Keep terminal surfaces as-is and require a broader Control UI/admin model before adding another permission-management command.

recommendation.title: Define scoped admin inventory
recommendation.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges approved pairing store, config allowlists, directory labels, and an explicitly chosen activity source under redaction and account-scope rules.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest combined history across `/allowlist`, pairing CLI, allow-from store behavior, and security-sensitive policy routing surfaces.
